## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The change raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/reset.py` and `app/signup.py`, and both modules now enforce `len(password) >= 12` correctly. I found no defects in the changed files. The PR body says this raises the minimum "in the password validators", but `app/invite.py:1` still sets `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, and `tests/test_invite.py` still asserts `length >= 8`. As a result, the invite flow still accepts 8–11 character passwords. The diff doesn't touch those files, so they aren't filed as findings, but you should check whether this PR was meant to update them too.

## Strengths
- I read `tests/test_reset.py:6` and `tests/test_signup.py:6`. Both now test lengths 11, 12 and 13 against `length >= 12`, which covers both sides of the new boundary. The tests would fail if either constant stayed at 8 or used `>` instead of `>=`. I read the tests but didn't run them.
